title: Project B. Experimental: Eagle flight computer sounding
source: pbe-eagle-flight-computer-2026-11-19-clean.csv (High Altitude Science Eagle, firmware 1.6, S2 temperature/pressure sensor)
altitude_reference: GPS altitude above mean sea level (m)
pressure_flag_rule: 'sensor floor' when pressure_pa <= 18700, or the row is between the floor reading (2026-11-19T23:06:54Z) and the first fresh descent fix below 12938 m (2026-11-20T00:26:36Z), or a fresh GPS altitude is at or above 12938 m. Flagged pressure values are not real atmospheric pressure.
fields_not_in_log: wind (not measured; only GPS ground track)
